chain_words.nuance: mild annoyance that builds up slowly
general feeling of displeasure or rage
very strong anger that is hard to control
anger so intense that it seems out of control

explanation: These words all express anger, from mild irritation that builds up slowly to rage that seems out of control.

usage_notes.difference: 'Angry' is the general word for displeasure; 'furious' is much stronger and suggests very intense anger that is hard to control.
